_note: The list of PIPELINE assets the mirror holds - the merged text encoder, the VAEs, the Identity Edit LoRA, whatever a pipeline's constants.py still names - plus the node packs and the upstream repos to pin. mirror_to_hf.py has no built-in list.

The catalogue's models and style LoRAs are NOT listed here. They live in the licence-server DB (the loras and models collections) and each record carries its own `mirror` {repo, path}: mirror_to_hf.py uploads every LoRA whose `mirror` is null and then records where it put it. Adding a LoRA is a DB edit, never an edit here.
Run `mirror_to_hf.py --audit` to be told which catalogue records have no mirror.
A pipeline entry stays here after the pipeline's constants.py stops mentioning it - that is the point of a mirror.
local/path_in_repo are relative to MODELS_DIR and the repo root.
source.kind: civitai | hf | dir | abliterated_merge | local

pin_upstream: repos pinned to a revision in PINS.json. An hf repo pinned here that no item mirrors from (the Comfy-Org ones) is upstream-only on purpose - a catalogue record sourced from it needs no mirror.

items.note: merged shards - mirroring this skips the runtime merge
needs the v1.2 nodes (fit geometry + ref_boost)
~12.2 GB UNet, not in the catalogue. Enable with --include-disabled or flip this flag.
